description: Albion Timber is a hardwood timber merchants based in Sheffield, Yorkshire. We specialise in native species and stock a large variety of sawn boards for furniture and joinery use. We also have a retail shop onsite stocked full of interesting species, all kiln dried and planed ready for use. We sell all sizes of boards, as well as turning and carving blanks. We also supply oil finishes including Rubio Monocoat, and stock a range of hardware including shelf brackets and metal table legs. We're open to the public 6 days a week, Monday - Friday 8am-5pm and Saturday 9am-1pm.
